kept.title: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` listed as required but also described as replaceable by `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`
kept.desc: The "Required environment variable" table and the optional table ("fallback LLM provider when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is unset") contradict each other; state which is truly required and whether OpenRouter alone suffices.

kept.title: Vercel filesystem limitation understated for analytics
kept.desc: CLAUDE.md notes Vercel Functions can only write to `/tmp`, so an analytics/cache write to a repo-relative path would fail with a read-only-filesystem error rather than merely "not persist"; the README should say whether such writes error out (and whether they are caught) instead of implying benign non-persistence, and it omits the LLM cache limitation CLAUDE.md mentions.
